subject: reasoning
question: If PUBLIC is coded as 7343186 and SACRED is coded as 10269108, then how will VICTORY be coded?
solution:
According to the English alphabet series and its positional value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1196a07d03c9f02e7bec22cfc36a195fd3a58e076da25a1e2a394b79aea80ec7.png] 

The logic follows here is:

Letter's positional value which has a single-digit is multiplied by 2.

Letter's positional value which has 2 digits has added the digits.

For example place value 16 coded as 1+6 = 7, 12 coded as 1+2 = 3

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f9fa48a8bf06f9e28b85f43a1748e1a4ea536d8a28d71718cfd35ac2c75d8b9.png] 

And;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e5b83a5c23c775e2df357d70b542654b6c68a768e67743fd156aa096db972ed.png] 

Similarly;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c0c7403f6eb5d4fdcb54fd5b37c6a92fa5876ea279c4b5998adaefc7af6d021.png] 

Hence, **"41862697"** is the correct answer.
